## distance matrix generation for group 1

```bash
vim dmat_rmtrans.sh

#!/bin/bash
###
#job name
#SBATCH --job-name=dmat_rmtrans
#job stdoutput file
#SBATCH --output=/scratch/SCWF00035/people/b.dvb25fyc_david/BEARCAVE2/dmat_rmtrans_pro/dmat_rmtrans_out%J
#job stderror file
#SBATCH --error=/scratch/SCWF00035/people/b.dvb25fyc_david/BEARCAVE2/dmat_rmtrans_pro/dmat_rmtrans_err%J
#maximum job time in D-HH:MM
#SBATCH --time=1-10:00
#number of nodes (axel almost never needs more than 1)
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#number of parallel processes (tasks) in CPU'S
#SBATCH --ntasks=16
#memory in Gb
#SBATCH --mem=120G
#assign account
#SBATCH --account=SCWF00035_a_barlow_33

module purge
module load angsd/0.935

ref='/scratch/SCWF00035/BEARCAVE0/refgenomes/rVipBer3/GCA_964194415.1_newheaders.fa'

#-rf = specified chromosomes

angsd -doIBS 1 -makeMatrix 1 -doCounts 1 -doMajorMinor 1 -GL 1 -minFreq 0.1 -minInd 29 -minQ 30 -minMapQ 30 -b /scratch/SCWF00035/people/b.dvb25fyc_david/BEARCAVE2/bamlists/mod_nhm_dmat_good -ref $ref -out /scratch/SCWF00035/people/b.dvb25fyc_david/BEARCAVE2/dmat_rmtrans_pro/dmat_rmtrans -nThreads 10 -rmTrans 1 -trim 5 -rf /scratch/SCWF00035/BEARCAVE0/refgenomes/rVipBer3/autosomes.txt
```
